name: dermacare-hospital-root
description: DermaCare Hospital Monorepo - Frontend (Vercel) + Backend (Render) + Database (Supabase)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
